desc:
Game is still a work in progress, you can use the in-game report feature to report any issues you find! Everything is appreciated!

Piggy but with old models, old themes, Little Brother bots, and no traitor mode!

Do you have what it takes to escape Piggy and uncover the mysteries surrounding the beast?

Controls:
Items (pick up & use): PC: Click, Mobile: Tap, or Right Trigger on Controller
Crouch & trap abilities: PC: Control/Click, Mobile: Tap, or B on controller
